relevance_note: A narrative review of retinal vasculitis that mentions TNFAIP3 only in one summary sentence citing another study ("A novel Behçet’s-like autoinflammatory disease was recently reported due to mutations in TNFAIP3", ref 12), with no patient-level genotype or phenotype data.
method_note: Read the whole paper manually; no script transcription of tables. The paper is a review ("This review focuses on new developments..."). Its only TNFAIP3 content is a group-level summary of reference 12 (Zhou Q et al., 2016, PMID:26642243): no individual, variant, count or per-person phenotype is given, so per the instructions only the publications row is filled and the other tables are empty. The one individual described first-hand (Figure 1, a 25-year-old Saudi male with Behcet's disease) has no TNFAIP3 variant reported and was not extracted. n_patients_reported and cites_prior_report_of_same_patients are null because the paper states neither. No contradictions relevant to HA20 found. Unrelated oddities: 'Key Points' numbers two items as '2)', and reference 29 (Springer TA 1990, adhesion receptors) does not match the IL-17 trial claim it is cited for.

study_type.span: This review focuses on new developments in the understanding and treatment of retinal vasculitis.
